verdict.rationale: Zep's documented data types for the Context Graph are explicitly limited to 'JSON, text, and message' (zep-docs-2), and other docs describe ingesting chat messages, business data, documents, and JSON (zep-docs-27) without any mention of image or PDF file uploads or extraction. There is no evidence anywhere in the pack of a file-upload API, image parsing, or PDF ingestion pipeline, so the specific capability of storing and recalling images/PDFs as memory is unevidenced.
